answers.core: I think it's a very common need to have a Goap system, but it's extremely hard to learn for novice programmers. Having a core goap system, that is well documented, would be a plus to all godot developers, in my opinion. I'm actually already working on a c++ module implementation for Godot 4. All I need is feedback to see if the community wants this.
answers.workaround: It's often the case where complex AI is needed, but implementation in GDscript can be cumbersome. So an integrated solution would be better.
